history_source: JRA netkeiba pre-race newspaper HTML: dl.HorseList > .Past_Wrapper li.Past .Data24 and dd.Performance
old_snapshot_source_status: JRA Nov 7-8 .keiba contains last-three past runs but no raw Data24 and no full-career Performance; cannot reconstruct lifetime record or exact race-short-note returns

same_course_good_run.definition: last three starts contain a same venue, same surface, same distance finish <=3

limitations: In-sample association only; course familiarity correlates with horse quality and campaign selection
Not full career; nonmatches also include missing or zero exposure
No valid return-on-stake gain for actual lifetime records or Data24 remarks can be claimed from archived 7/8 snapshots
No automatic mark, bonus, buy list, or betting system should be generated from exploratory associations

prospective_conditions.race_window: 2026-11-14 onward; pre-race snapshots with verifiable saved time before post only

career.feature: exact current racecourse, surface and distance pre-race total
career.signal: observed >=1 third-or-better finish with >=1 start; always retain sample count
career.caution: Never convert 0 starts into poor performance, never synthesize missing

remarks.source: Only literal past Data24 with date and horse id matched
remarks.denominator: all horses with source remarks available

performance.compare_to: same ability strata with matched pre-race source coverage, plus original pure ability rank 1 and top3 baseline
performance.no_deployment_until: Holdout replication across 2+ weekends and clear return improvement, not post-hoc on development data
